earnings.title: Yum! Brands Reports Third-Quarter Results
highlights: Third-quarter GAAP EPS was $5.92 and third-quarter EPS excluding Special Items was $1.56.
Returns $1.8 Billion to Shareholders Through Dividends and Share Repurchases Year-to-Date;
Digital system sales over $9 billion, with digital mix reaching 64%.

quotes.text: Yum! has entered its next chapter of growth, having completed the divestiture of Pizza Hut, with a sharper focus on our Raise the B.A.R. priorities.
